title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
description:
An `m x n` grid `heights` gives the height of each cell of an island. The **Pacific** ocean touches the island's top and left edges; the **Atlantic** ocean touches its bottom and right edges.

Rain water can flow from a cell to a neighboring cell (up, down, left, right) whose height is **less than or equal** to its own, and water on any border cell can flow into the adjacent ocean.

Return every cell `[row, col]` from which water can reach **both** oceans, in any order.

examples.explanation: The only cell touches both oceans.

hints: Instead of starting from every cell, search backwards from each ocean: from the ocean edge, move to neighbors that are equal or higher.
The answer is the intersection of the cells reached from the Pacific and from the Atlantic.
